note: FFX_Kernel_LoadFileToTable keeps command/ply_rom/a_ability/item sizes (rounded up to 16 bytes) in 16 bits, so these payloads must stay <= 65,520 bytes; monmagic1/2 pass through a 0x25800 buffer. When a translated table would exceed its limit, these reviewed slots keep the native text; if that is not enough the whole table stays native.
